name: lofi-nullpoint
description: Lo-fi OS dialog: a photo dithered to one bit (4×4 Bayer, ink on paper) in a Windows-98 window on a checkered blue desktop, a dialog over it with the mark as its icon, the name in 5×7 bitmap type built from squares, a block progress bar, a pointer on OK, desktop icons and a taskbar. Square (release): the window and the dialog re-set on the square, the name in bitmap type and the title in Silkscreen over the progress bar. The bitmap type, the pointer and the window chrome are baked path and shape data (covers has no bitmap font or OS chrome); the desktop checker is an svg pattern. Re-expressed from the Logomarks scenes lab (FlyerCards3, 'Lo-fi · OS dialog').
